_about: Captured from the real ffmpeg on 2026-10-11 by the commands below (stderr, verbatim). The signals are ffmpeg's own pink noise, not speech: the voice step only reads the summary's format and numbers. No audio file is kept.
ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 8.0.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2025 the FFmpeg developers

hot.txt.signal: ffmpeg -nostdin -v error -y -f lavfi -i anoisesrc=color=pink:amplitude=0.36:seed=7:sample_rate=48000:duration=3 -f lavfi -i "aevalsrc=exprs='if(between(t\,1.5\,1.5004)\,0.75\,0)':sample_rate=48000:duration=3" -filter_complex "[0:a][1:a]amix=inputs=2:normalize=0" -ac 1 -c:a pcm_s16le -bitexact hot.wav

v-error.txt.note: empty: ebur128 logs its summary at the info level

narrated-mp4.txt.signal: a narrated synthetic render of video 1 (16 of Ruth's cached clips, 79.667 s), made by python -m showcase.render.synthetic --voice-cache and python -m showcase.render on 2026-10-15; the file itself is not kept
narrated-mp4.txt.kept: the last 65,536 characters of stderr (what showcase.render.sound.loudness reads), from the first whole line
